theme: 物流・在庫管理とエネルギー営業の現場：比較・分詞・接続詞を総点検

p5.q: The new distribution center is significantly ___ than the old one.
p5.exp: 後ろに than → 比較級 larger。significantly は比較級を強める副詞。

p5.q: ___ receipt of your payment, we will ship your order immediately.
p5.exp: upon receipt of 〜＝〜を受け取り次第。ビジネス文書の定番表現。

p5.q: Ms. Park prefers to check the delivery invoices ___.
p5.exp: 「自分で」と主語を強調する再帰代名詞 herself。文が完成しているので目的格 her は入らない。

p5.q: We look forward to ___ with your company again next year.
p5.exp: look forward to の to は前置詞 → 動名詞 working。to＋原形と間違えやすい。

p5.q: Sales of portable gas heaters ___ steadily since early October.
p5.exp: since＋過去の起点 → 現在完了 have risen。過去形 rose は since と合わない。

p5.q: The shipment arrived ___ two days ahead of schedule.
p5.exp: 数詞 two days を修飾 → 副詞 approximately（約）。

p5.q: The supplier ___ products we ordered last month has raised its prices.
p5.exp: 空所の後ろが名詞 products で「その供給業者の製品」→ 所有格 whose。

p5.q: Orders will not be processed ___ payment has been confirmed.
p5.exp: 「支払いが確認されない限り処理しない」→ unless（〜でない限り）。

p5.q: Our technicians will ___ the gas meters at all customer sites next week.
p5.exp: メーターを「点検する」→ inspect。-spect で終わる似た語のひっかけ。

p5.q: Customers were ___ with the quick response from our service team.
p5.exp: 人が「満足させられた」→ 過去分詞 satisfied。satisfying は「（物事が）満足させる」。

p5.q: Demand was ___ high that the warehouse had to hire temporary staff.
p5.exp: so＋形容詞＋that〜＝とても…なので〜。such は such a＋名詞の形で使う。

p5.q: All boxes must be clearly labeled ___ they are loaded onto the truck.
p5.exp: 後ろが節で「積み込む前に」→ 接続詞 before。during/despite は前置詞、until は意味が合わない。

p2.q: When will the new delivery trucks arrive?
p2.exp: When → 時を答える。Not until〜＝〜まで来ない（＝〜に来る）。At the loading dock は Where への答え。

p2.q: Why was the meeting with the client postponed?
p2.exp: Why → 理由。postponed と posted の音のひっかけ、疑問詞疑問文に Yes で答えない。

p2.q: Could you send me the updated price list?
ch: Sure, I'll email it right away.
p2.exp: 依頼 → 引き受ける応答。price / updated の繰り返しはひっかけ。

p2.q: Should we ship the order by air or by truck?
ch: Trucks are cheaper, so let's use one.
p2.exp: 選択疑問文 → どちらかを選ぶ。Yes/No は不自然。air の繰り返しはひっかけ。

p2.q: You've met our new regional manager, haven't you?
ch: Yes, at last week's training session.
p2.exp: 付加疑問 → Yes＋会った場面で自然に応答。manager/manages の音のひっかけ。

p2.q: The gas cylinder at the restaurant needs to be replaced.
ch: I'll arrange a delivery this afternoon.
p2.exp: 平叙文（報告）→ 対応策を返すのが自然。replaced と placed の音のひっかけ。

p2.q: Who approved the budget for the warehouse expansion?
p2.exp: Who → 人物。金額は How much への答え。

p2.q: Isn't the inventory report due today?
ch: The deadline was moved to Monday.
p2.exp: 否定疑問 → 「締切が月曜に変更された」と間接的に答える。Yes, I'll do it は「今日締切ではないのか」への応答として噛み合わない。

script.t: Hello, this is Sandra from the Westfield warehouse. I'm calling about the order of packing materials we placed last week.
Hi, Sandra. I'm afraid there's been a delay. The storm closed the highway, so our trucks couldn't leave the factory.
That's a problem. We're running low on boxes, and we have a large shipment going out on Friday.
I understand. We have about half of your order in stock at our local branch. I could send that part today.
That would help a lot. And the rest?
It should reach you by Monday. I'll e-mail you the tracking numbers this afternoon.

qs.q: Why has the order been delayed?
ch: A road was closed because of bad weather.
The factory ran out of materials.
A truck broke down on the way.
qs.exp: The storm closed the highway → 悪天候で道路が閉鎖（言い換え）。

qs.q: What does the man offer to do?
ch: Send part of the order right away
qs.exp: half of your order ... I could send that part today → 一部を即日発送。

script.t: Thank you for meeting me, Mr. Lopez. You mentioned your restaurant's water heater is getting old?
Yes, it's over fifteen years old, and our gas bills have gone up a lot this year.
Newer models use about twenty percent less gas. We could replace it during your closed day so it won't affect your business.
That sounds good, but I need to know the total cost first. I have to discuss it with my business partner.
Of course. I'll prepare a detailed estimate, including installation, and bring it by on Thursday.

qs.q: What problem does the man mention?
ch: His staff cannot use the equipment.
qs.exp: our gas bills have gone up a lot → 光熱費（エネルギーコスト）の上昇。

qs.q: What will the woman do on Thursday?
qs.exp: prepare a detailed estimate ... bring it by on Thursday → 見積もりを持参。設置はまだ決まっていない。

p7.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL WAREHOUSE STAFF

Our annual inventory count will take place on Saturday, December 5. The warehouse will be closed to deliveries and customer pickups that day. All staff members in the shipping and receiving departments are required to attend.

The count will begin at 8:00 A.M. and is expected to finish by 3:00 P.M. Lunch will be provided in the break room. Please wear your safety shoes and bring your employee ID card.

Employees who work on Saturday will receive an extra day off, to be taken before the end of January. Please submit your preferred date to your supervisor by December 1.

Questions may be directed to Alan Brooks, Warehouse Operations.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
ch: To explain a change in delivery fees
To request feedback on safety rules
qs.exp: 冒頭の Our annual inventory count will take place → 棚卸しの告知。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as something staff should do?
ch: Tell a supervisor their preferred day off
qs.exp: NOT問題。昼食は Lunch will be provided（支給される）ので持参不要。他の3つは本文に記載あり。

qs.q: What will employees who work on December 5 receive?
qs.exp: an extra day off → Additional time off への言い換え。

p7.passage:
From: Customer Service, Southfield Energy
To: Ms. Helen Carter
Subject: Scheduled safety inspection

Dear Ms. Carter,

As required by regulations, we inspect the gas equipment at every customer's home once every four years. Your inspection is scheduled for Wednesday, December 9, between 1:00 P.M. and 4:00 P.M. The inspection takes about thirty minutes and is free of charge.

Our technician will check your gas meter, hoses, and water heater. Someone over the age of eighteen must be at home during the visit. If this time is not convenient, please call us at least three days in advance to choose another date.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Southfield Energy

qs.q: Why was the e-mail sent to Ms. Carter?
ch: To inform her of a regular check of her equipment
To confirm her order for a new water heater
To remind her of an unpaid bill
To announce an increase in gas prices
qs.exp: 定期（4年に1回）の保安点検の案内。regular check は once every four years の言い換え。

qs.q: What is indicated about the inspection?
ch: There is no fee for it.
It is done once a year.
Ms. Carter does not need to be home.
qs.exp: free of charge → There is no fee（言い換え）。所要は約30分、4年に1回、18歳以上の在宅が必要。

qs.q: What should Ms. Carter do if she wants to change the date?
ch: Contact the company by phone in advance
Reply to the e-mail on the inspection day
Ask the technician during the visit
qs.exp: please call us at least three days in advance → 事前に電話で連絡。
